subject: Proposal: Partial prepay + automated ACH schedule; VAT reverse-charge for EU entity
messages:
From: Samantha Liu <samantha.liu@medicore.com>

Cc: accounts-payments@medicore.com
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: shift to Net60 for November invoices (temporary)

Hi Neha,

Hope you're well — quick ask from our side. We're running a month-end tightness across a few EU subsidiaries and need to request a temporary move to Net60 for November and December invoices for the MediCore EU entity (VAT ID attached).

We expect to revert to our standard Net30 after that (Jan 2027). If there's any flexibility on deposit or a partial prepay to bridge the gap, we can consider it — happy to discuss.

Appreciate a quick confirmation so we can flag this to our AP team.

Thanks,
Samantha Liu
Director, Procurement
MediCore Systems

Attachments: MediCore-VAT-cert.pdf

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>

Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 10:34:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: shift to Net60 for November invoices (temporary)

Thanks for the note, Samantha — appreciate the heads up. I'm looping in Priyom (sales operations) and Marissa (finance) to work through a compromise that protects our cash while giving MediCore some runway.

Quick proposal from our side to keep this moving: 
- For invoices dated 11/2026 and 12/2026, Redwood can accept a temporary Net45 instead of Net60.
- As a condition, we ask for a 40% partial prepay for the month of November (applied to the Nov invoice) and an automated ACH schedule for the remaining balance: 50% of the outstanding after prepay on Day 30, final 50% on Day 45.
- For December invoices, 30% prepay, remainder on Net45.
- We will treat this as a one-time amendment; standard Net30 resumes for invoices issued from 2027-01-01.

Two operational asks for EU VAT handling:
1) Please confirm the MediCore EU VAT ID and let us know if you intend to use reverse-charge. If yes, invoices must show your VAT ID and the reverse-charge note.
2) We need a signed ACH mandate (attached form) and the PO number for November so we can attach the schedule to the invoice.

Attaching a draft payment-plan.xlsx that models the schedule. If this looks reasonable, Priyom can put together the amendment and send a DocuSign for signature.

-Neha
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0198

Attachments: draft-payment-plan.xlsx, ACH-mandate-form.pdf

Subject: Re: Request: shift to Net60 for November invoices (temporary)

Hi Samantha — following up from Neha's proposal. A few clarifications from ops/finance (short bullets):
- We can operationalize Net45 with the prepay/ACH schedule Neha outlined.
- For accounting, please confirm the PO number you want on the Nov invoice and attach the signed ACH mandate (we provided the blank form in the previous email).
- VAT: if MediCore wants Redwood to zero-rate the invoice under reverse-charge, we need the EU VAT ID and a written confirmation e-mail that your entity will account for VAT under reverse-charge. The VAT cert you attached looks fine but we need a short confirmation line in this thread for audit.
- Once we have the PO + signed mandate + VAT confirmation, I'll generate an amendment (DocuSign) and milestone invoice schedule in our billing system.

If it's helpful, we can also do a one-time credit hold (15 days) on 20% of the account balance while the schedule runs; we'd only use that if cash-flow risk remains. Let me know if you want that option.

Thanks,
Priyom
Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
